newsitem.title: UK: April Forties programme lower at 26.6 mln barrels.
newsitem.headline: April Forties programme lower at 26.6 mln barrels.

text.p: April's British North Sea Forties programme scheduled liftings totalling 26.6 million barrels, down from 28.45 million in March, traders said on Monday.
The difference, 1.85 million barrels, is equivalent to 3.7 standard 500,000 barrel cargoes.
But with April one day shorter than March the daily difference amounts to just 30,000 barrels a day (bpd) at 887,000 bpd in April versus 918,000 bpd in March.
April's loading programme is made up of 27 cargoes of 600,000 barrels each, 14 of 500,000 barrels and one each of 550,000, 650,000 and 700,000 barrels.
The cargoes load at the Grangemouth terminal in eastern Scotland.
The April programme also includes 1.5 million barrels direct for Forties pipeline operator BP's Grangemouth refinery.
The March programme included 24 cargoes of 600,000 barrels, 19 of 500,000, two of 550,000 and one each of one million barrels and 900,000 barrels in addition to 1.55 million direct to Grangemouth.
